notes.title: This is Gnaughty Gnomes (Devlog 1)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're Sand Castles Studio, a small indie team of 8 people. Three years ago, we developed Bread & Fred, the co-op game where two penguins climb a mountain while tied together with a rope.

In February, we announced our new multiplayer game: Gnaughty Gnomes. Yep, it's a game about gnomes, but these gnomes fight to the death! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477024/d02baeb45bf6dabd366f7dbadaaeb44c57986520.jpg

This time, we're here to share some updates on its development in this first devlog (more to come!): how we came up with the idea, what the game's all about, and what you can expect from the gameplay.

How did it all start?

One random afternoon, we came across Bloodroots, that fast-paced game where you can use almost anything in the environment as a weapon. And that sparked a question: ''What if the characters were gnomes? And what if they started brawling with whatever they could grab?''

That's how our new project was born: a chaotic multiplayer game for 2 to 4 players, where matches are quick, the maps are tight, and the goal is simple: be the last gnome standing.

[previewyoutube=RXRRphn2cRk;full][/previewyoutube]

What can you do in Gnaughty Gnomes?

▪️Throw ANYTHING you find on the ground
▪️Punch your enemies in +20 themed maps
▪️Choose between +120 skill cards 
▪️Dodge like a ninja
▪️Taunt your friends with goofy emotes

In a nutshell, we could say that Gnaughty Gnomes is a mix between Bloodroots, Party Animals, Rounds and Boomerang Fu.

Chaos... with upgrades

After a couple of rounds, each player gets to choose a random upgrade from hundreds of options. Some are useful, others are... well, completely chaotic. But they all shake up the gameplay. And once everyone has a few upgrades stacked, the match turns into a full-on festival of chaos and laughs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477024/2bce2a3b54ec8dcb9444ba6ffcdaa7ac08c6745e.jpg

If you like the game, you can try its demo and add it to your wishlist to help us give it more visibility.

We'll keep sharing our progress through more devlogs. Stay tuned!

And stay in touch with us through our social media.

See you soon!

notes.title: Gnaughty Gnomes demo is out now
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Gnaughty Gnomes demo is now available and you can try it for free starting today.

👊 Become a fighting gnome!

Gnaughty Gnomes is a very crazy and frantic party game in which you:

🔹 Use any object on the stage as a weapon.
🔹 Choose cards of different rarities. 
🔹 Fight on themed maps 
🔹 Customize your gnome
🔹 Taunt your enemies with gestures.

[previewyoutube=D4AJXis_yO4;full][/previewyoutube]
🎮 What's included in the demo?

In this first playable version you can enjoy:

🔹 10 different maps (5 Aquarium and 5 Airport)
🔹 45 upgrade cards with different synergies (the final version will have more than 100)
🔹 15 customization options per body part
🔹 3 win games, with upgrade selection between each round

🛠️ We want your feedback

This demo is very important to us. We would love to know what you think about the game. If you feel like it, leave us your comments, ideas, funny clips or bugs you find in the community forum or on our Discord.

☺️ Thanks for your support

If you enjoy the demo, don't forget to add Gnaughty Gnomes to your wishlist. You will help us a lot and you will be up to date with all the news.

Remember that you can also follow us on our social networks.

See you soon!
